popupExpandToggleTip: Instead of capturing the inner scrolling panels and iframes as they appear, make them as big as their entire content. For a frame of another site an additional permission is asked only one time.
optionsLead: Changes are saved automatically and are synced into your browser profile.
optionsExpandPermGranted: The permission has been obtained — frames of another site are widened too.
optionsExpandPermMissing: Without the "read all websites" permission, frames of another site are captured just as they appear. Panels and iframes of that same site always work.
optionsRedactPIIDesc: In the text that the page exposes it finds e-mails, telephone numbers, credit card numbers, national identity numbers (SSN) and API keys and places a dense black block over what is found, in the saved image. It cannot read text drawn as pixels — canvas, image, PDF, video frame. The recognition runs on your own device; nothing at all is ever sent anywhere. This applies to captures of the whole page (document scroll); the block is permanent, so check the result yourself.
scrollclipFormatHint: GIF runs everywhere. WebM is small and more smooth (it is recorded live right in your browser).
batchPermissionHint: To open these pages a permission of only one time is needed the first time.
batchPermissionDeclined: The permission to open those pages was denied.
redactActsNone: The redaction found nothing matching in the text it read and did not draw any block. Nothing below is outlined.
redactActsShortfall: The redaction found 3 matches and covered 2.
redactActsUncoveredOne: 1 match is not covered in this image.
redactActsUncoveredOther: 2 matches are not covered in this image.
reviewLimit: FullShot reads the text the page opens up. It cannot see this image. Anything drawn as pixels – canvas, image, PDF page, video frame – was never read.
reviewNoMarks: No block is outlined in the image below.
